title: fix(app-shell): pass the package binding to the delegated-admin companion list explicitly
body:
Fixes #26349

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:权限集编辑器把「是否在包下编辑」显式告诉委派管理员的配套授权清单(两处挂载都传 `packageBound={!!packageId}`),清单不再从展示方式 `only` 推断。
- 为什么改:旧推断把两个无关属性绑在一起,今天碰巧成立;将来某个宿主只设其一就会显示错的面孔(该打勾却不打,或反之)。
- 风险与回滚:作者今天看到的界面不变(Studio 访问支柱总在包下,Setup 权限页从不在包下);回滚即还原本 PR 一个提交。
- 先看:`PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` 的 `packageBound` 默认值与注释;`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 两处挂载;新钉 `PermissionMatrixEditor.companionPackageBinding.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.companionPackageBinding.test.tsx` → 4 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `PermissionMatrixEditPage` passes `packageBound={!!packageId}` to `PermissionAdvancedFacets` at both mounts: the Studio presentation (the facet tabs, which set `only`) and Setup's stacked page.
- `PermissionAdvancedFacets`'s `packageBound` prop now defaults to `false` instead of `only !== undefined`; its doc comment says the host passes its own binding and that `only` picks a presentation, not a binding.
- No author-visible change today: the Studio Access pillar always edits under a `packageId`, and Setup's permission page never does. A host that sets one without the other now gets the face of its binding.

## Tests

- New pin `PermissionMatrixEditor.companionPackageBinding.test.tsx`: drives the real `PermissionMatrixEditPage` load path against a fake client, the set's scope naming a business unit, and reads `data-granted` on `admin-companion-setup.access` on both mounts, with and without a `packageId` (absent under a package, present otherwise).
- Adjusted pin `PermissionAdvancedFacets.companionGrants-26191.test.tsx`: its two cases that relied on the `only`-based default ("the Studio Access pillar mount ... is package-bound by default" and "an explicit packageBound={false} on that mount keeps the action") now pin the decoupled behaviour: `only` alone keeps the marks and the grant action; `only` with an explicit `packageBound` lists the grants unmarked with no action. Its other eight cases are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Red first, on the base source (`e2129cbf`) with the new and adjusted pins: 3 failed, 11 passed. The reds were exactly the Setup mount under a package (marked when it should not be), the Studio mount at environment scope (unmarked when it should be), and the adjusted `only`-alone facet case.
- Ablation of the Studio mount's wiring (the one leg the base run cannot show, since the old default already made that mount package-bound): deleting its `packageBound` line turns "Studio mount, under a package" red (1 failed, 3 passed), restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- No sdui manifest record: app-shell has none since each registry package carries its own record.
- `origin/main` moved by six commits after the branch point; none touches `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, so the branch was not merged before opening. CI and the merge queue run on the merge ref.
